item.title: Park District plans 2026 events
item.description: PREBLE COUNTY — The Preble County Park District has announced its schedule of programs and special events planned for 2026, offering a series of guided nature programs, educational opportunities and outdoor recreation throughout the year. item.title: Shawnee musicians play with OMEA Honor Band
item.description: MASON — Four Preble Shawnee band students performed Sunday, Jan. 18, at Mason High School as members of the Ohio Music Education Association District 13 Honor Band. item.title: Snow Emergency canceled in Montgomery County
item.description: DAYTON — Montgomery County Sheriff Rob Streck has canceled a Snow Emergency, effective February 6, at 1 p.m. for all of Montgomery County. A Level 1 Snow Emergency had been put into effect at 10 a.m. but is now lifted. The post Snow Emergency canceled in Montgomery County appeared first on The Register Herald.
